Captured by replaying Claude Edit and Write PreToolUse/PostToolUse payloads through installed git-ai 1.7.5 in an isolated daemon, 2026-10-28. Native session ids are synthetic; the s_ session keys are regenerated from them the way git-ai derives them (first 14 hex of sha256("<tool>:<native id>")), and trace ids are kept; transcript path is sanitized. original-failing-note is the sanitized note from a private commit (its base_commit_sha is an invented placeholder): its checkpoint archive was already pruned, and its s_ session key is a placeholder, not derived from any native id. Tests adapt the captured native note id to the original failing s_ fallback shape, and adapt file/trace identities when pairing existing engine fixtures. The replay itself produced native ids in the note; it did not reproduce the fallback. Mapping requires harvesting the checkpoint before its log is pruned.
